== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1684. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-3012|John Glasgow]] and [[Currie-4998|Margaret Currie]].
* Fact: Christening (13 Apr 1684)  , Glencorse, Midlothian, Scotland

m Thomas Archibald
